title: Ostat (staff)
body:
Syntax: ostat <vnum or name>

Description: Shows an item prototype's full stat block, including weapon resistances and timed medical healing. Wielded items show Hitroll, Damageroll, and Damage. Set them directly with 'oset <vnum> hitroll|damageroll|damage <n>'; damage overrides the weapontype default for that item.

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
